comment_browser_profile_dir: Persistent browser profile dir. A leading ~ expands against HOME; when HOME is unavailable (systemd units, hosting panels running as root) a leftover ~ is re-anchored under the magic home instead of being handed to Chrome as a relative path. Set "" for a fresh temp profile each start. Prefer an absolute path on servers.

image_gen.comment_api_key: Image generation key for the image_gen / image_edit tools. Empty = both tools stay out of the model's tool list. IMAGE_GEN_API_KEY overrides this value.
image_gen.comment_base_url: Override the API base (self-hosted or relay gateway). Empty = official endpoint per provider.

video_gen.comment_api_key: Video generation key for the video_generate tool. Empty = the tool stays out of the model's tool list. VIDEO_GEN_API_KEY overrides this value.
video_gen.comment_provider: dashscope (Alibaba Model Studio, wan series; default) or volcengine (Volcano Ark, Seedance series). Both are submit-task + poll async APIs; the tool polls internally and downloads the MP4 (video URLs expire after 24h).
video_gen.comment_base_url: Override the API base (self-hosted or relay gateway). Empty = official endpoint per provider.
video_gen.comment_model: Model override. dashscope: wan2.2-t2v-plus (t2v) / wan2.2-i2v-plus (i2v, auto-swapped when a first-frame image is given). volcengine: e.g. doubao-seedance-1-0-pro-250528.

tools.comment_enabled_disabled: Toolset switches (tools page in the web UI). Values are group ids: file, web, browser, terminal, coding, media, desktop, memory, task, kanban, delegation, skills, interaction, utility, mcp — or a single tool name, or "all". disabled hides the group from the model; an enabled entry can exempt one group/tool. enabled is NOT a whitelist: items not listed stay enabled.
tools.comment_strict_command_list: true = execute_command only accepts the well-known toolchain list (npx/gofmt/dlv etc. get rejected). The list is a hint, not a security boundary.

bot_mode.comment_inject_bot_protocol: Add the bot-to-bot messaging protocol section to every bot's system prompt. Omit for the default (true).
bot_mode.comment_history_window: Messages kept per bot canonical chat, trimmed on turn boundaries. 0 = default (200, minimum 20).
bot_mode.comment_turn_timeout_minutes: Time limit for one inbound message (all LLM calls + tool runs). 0 = default (30), the same value agent.turn_timeout_minutes uses.
bot_mode.comment_relay_token: Shared secret remote instances must present on /api/relay/v1/dm. Empty = the relay only accepts requests from localhost; set a value to allow cross-machine peer DMs.

approval.comment_strategy: Global default strategy: smart (ask on high risk, auto-approve low risk), manual (ask for everything), auto (approve everything except catastrophic patterns), auto_narrow (approve low/medium, deny high/critical — for channels with no approval UI), whitelist (only whitelisted commands).
approval.comment_channel_overrides: Per-channel strategy override. Keys: web, cli, gateway, bot, unattended (cron/kanban workers). Unattended channels never inherit the global strategy: they use auto_narrow unless listed here, so background jobs neither block on a prompt nobody can answer nor silently run high-risk commands.
approval.comment_trust_threshold: Auto-approve a command pattern after it has been approved this many times.
approval.comment_enable_learning: Learn which command patterns the user approves/denies.
approval.comment_enable_cli_confirm: Ask before every tool call in interactive CLI sessions, even when the strategy would auto-approve it (read-only commands and whitelisted patterns are still not re-asked).
approval.comment_approval_timeout: Seconds to wait for an approval decision (CLI prompt and web card). On timeout timeout_strategy decides.
approval.comment_timeout_strategy: What to do on timeout: deny, allow_low_medium, allow_all.
approval.comment_dangerous_patterns: Extra regexes appended to the built-in hard-deny list (rm -rf /, mkfs, dd to a raw disk, fork bomb, shutdown/reboot …). Hard denies are never askable.
approval.comment_high_risk_patterns: Extra regexes appended to the built-in high-risk list (recursive deletion under /root, /usr, /etc …). Matches are escalated to critical: interactive channels ask, unattended channels deny.

cli.comment: CLI connectors: wrap command-line programs that have no MCP server. Each tool becomes cli_<connector>_<tool>. Args are passed as an argv array (no shell), so values containing spaces/semicolons stay literal. Templates: {{name}} inserts a parameter value (a lone placeholder with an empty value drops the whole argument, including a preceding --flag); an argument starting with {{?name}} is kept only when that parameter is truthy.

tools.name: pr_list
tools.description: List pull requests of a repository

policy.comment: Connector allowlist. enforce=true means config alone is not enough: an MCP server must match mcp_allowed_hosts (remote) or mcp_allowed_commands (stdio), and a CLI connector must match cli_allowed_commands. An empty list with enforce=true denies that whole category; '*' opens it. Host wildcards like *.example.com match subdomains only.
